create or alter procedure [api].[MergeAssetPaths] @executionId uniqueidentifier = null, @class int, @begin int, @end int as begin set nocount on;
drop table if exists #hierarchy drop table if exists #tbl drop table if exists #incoming drop table if exists #ids drop table if exists #tblgrp drop table if exists #illegalxml
create table #hierarchy ( GroupID bigint, AssetTypeID int, ID bigint, [Level] int, ParentID bigint, Code nvarchar(250) )
create table #tbl ( GroupID bigint, AssetTypeID int,
ID bigint, [Level] int, [Position] decimal(5,3),
ParentID bigint, ParentLevel int, ParentPosition decimal(5,3),
ColumnOrder int, FormattedValue nvarchar(max) )
create table #incoming (ID bigint)
create table #ids (GroupID bigint, ID bigint, ParentID bigint, [Path] nvarchar(2500), Segments xml)
insert into #incoming select AssetID from api.ExecutionAsset where ExecutionID = @executionId and ItemNumber between @begin and @end
if @class = 15 begin insert into #incoming select A.ID as AssetID from api.ExecutionDiagramAsset EDA inner join Asset A ON A.uid = EDA.Uid where ExecutionID = @executionId end
if exists (select top 1 * from #incoming) begin with descendants as ( select I.SubjectAssetID, I.ObjectAssetID from #incoming O inner join Asset A on O.ID = A.ID inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.SubjectAssetID = O.ID inner join Asset C on C.ID = I.ObjectAssetID union all select I.SubjectAssetID, I.ObjectAssetID from descendants c inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.SubjectAssetID = c.ObjectAssetID inner join Asset A on A.ID = I.ObjectAssetID ) insert into #incoming select ObjectAssetID from descendants;
create clustered index CIX_TempIncoming on #incoming (ID)
if @class = 15 --diagram asset, we need to go through a different relationship. begin with hierarchy as ( select DA.ID as GroupID, DA.AssetTypeID, DA.ID as AssetId, A.ID as ParentAssetId, DA.Code, 0 as [Level] from Asset A inner join AssetProcessDiagram D on D.AssetID = A.ID cross apply openjson(D.Diagram, '$.nodeDataArray') with (assetUid uniqueidentifier N'$.key') N inner join Asset DA on DA.Uid = N.assetUid inner join #incoming O on O.ID = DA.ID union all select c.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID as AssetId, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentAssetId, A.Code, c.[Level]-1 as [Level] from hierarchy c inner join Asset A on A.ID = c.ParentAssetId inner join [Intersect] I on I.ObjectAssetID = a.ID inner join [IntersectType] IT on IT.ID = I.IntersectTypeID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID where P.Type in (3,4)
)
insert into #hierarchy (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], ParentID, Code) select A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.AssetId, A.[Level], P.ID, A.Code from hierarchy A left join Asset P on P.ID = A.ParentAssetId; end else begin with hierarchy as ( select A.ID as GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, I.ObjectAssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentObjectAssetID, A.Code, 0 as [Level] from Asset A left join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID inner join #incoming O on O.ID = A.ID union all select c.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.ID ObjectAssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentObjectAssetID, A.Code, c.[Level]-1 as [Level] from hierarchy c inner join Asset A on c.ParentObjectAssetID = A.ID outer apply ( select I.SubjectAssetID from PredicateIntersect I where I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID ) I )
insert into #hierarchy (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], ParentID, Code) select A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], P.ID, A.Code from hierarchy A left join Asset P on P.ID = A.ParentObjectAssetID; end
if @class = 9 begin insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(5,3)) as Position, ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, Code from #hierarchy end else if @class = 11 begin create nonclustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (ID)
insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select GroupID, H.AssetTypeID, H.ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(5,3)) as Position, H.ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, F.FirstName + ' ' + F.LastName from #hierarchy H inner join Asset A on A.ID = H.ID inner join assettype att on att.id = a.AssetTypeID and att.Class = 11 inner join reporting.Global_Resource F on F.ResourceID = A.SourceID end else if @class = 12 begin create nonclustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (ID)
insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select GroupID, H.AssetTypeID, H.ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(5,3)) as Position, H.ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, F.Name from #hierarchy H inner join Asset A on A.ID = H.ID inner join assettype att on att.id = a.AssetTypeID and att.Class = 12 inner join dbo.[Group] F on F.ID = A.SourceID end else begin create nonclustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (AssetTypeID)
insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select distinct A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], cast(cast(A.[Level] as varchar) + '.' + cast(FT.ColumnOrder as varchar) as decimal(5,3)) as Position, A.ParentID, A.[Level] - 1, FT.ColumnOrder, F.FormattedValue from #hierarchy A inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 inner join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.AssetID = A.ID
--handle counter fields insert into #tbl (GroupID, AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select distinct A.GroupID, A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], cast(cast(A.[Level] as varchar) + '.' + cast(FT.ColumnOrder as varchar) as decimal(5,3)) as Position, A.ParentID, A.[Level] - 1, FT.ColumnOrder, coalesce(FT.CounterPrefix,'')+ cast(FCV.Value as nvarchar(20)) as FormattedValue from #hierarchy A inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 and FT.Type = 'Counter' inner join FieldCounterValue FCV on FCV.AssetId = A.Id and FCV.FieldTypeId = FT.Id end
create clustered index CIX_TempTbl on #tbl (GroupID)
if exists (select 1 from #tbl where [Level] < 1) begin update T set [Level] = [Level] + S.[LevelUp], [ParentLevel] = [ParentLevel] + S.[LevelUp] from #tbl T cross apply ( select abs(min([Level]))+1 as [LevelUp] from #tbl where GroupID = T.GroupID ) S end
insert into #ids (GroupID, ID, ParentID) select GroupID, ID, ParentID from #tbl group by GroupID, ID, ParentID;
create nonclustered index CIX_TempIds on #ids (ID,GroupID)
select s.groupid,(select t.[Level] as '@level', t.ColumnOrder as '@position', t.AssetTypeID as '@assetTypeId', t.ID as '@assetId', t.FormattedValue as 'data()' from #tbl t where t.GroupID = S.GroupID order by t.Position for xml path('segment'), root('path')) XMLData into #tblgrp from #tbl s group by s.groupid;
create nonclustered index CIX_tblgrp on #tblgrp (GroupID)
--The XML parser throws an 'illegal xml character' error when converting #tblgrp.XMLData to AssetNode.Segments --if XMLData contains escaped ASCII control characters such as Bell(x07), Device Control 3(x13) or File Seperator (x1C) --These characters should be rare, so only execute if the XMLData contains an encoded two digit hex value if exists (select 1 from #tblgrp where patindex('%&#x__;%', XMLData) > 0) begin create table #illegalxml ( Escaped NVARCHAR(6) );
WITH controlRange(V) AS ( SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT V + 1FROM controlRange WHERE V < 31 ) INSERT into #illegalxml (Escaped) SELECT '&#x'+RIGHT('00'+FORMAT(V, 'X'), 2)+';' FROM controlRange WHERE V NOT IN (9, 10, 13) --TAB, LF, CR
declare @replacePattern nvarchar(6) = null
set @replacePattern = ( select top 1 x.Escaped from #tblgrp t cross join #illegalxml x where charindex(x.Escaped, t.XMLData) > 0 )
while @replacePattern is not null begin update #tblgrp set XMLData = REPLACE(XMLData, @replacePattern, '') where patindex('%&#x__;%', XMLData) > 0;
set @replacePattern = ( select top 1 x.Escaped from #tblgrp t cross join #illegalxml x where charindex(x.Escaped, t.XMLData) > 0 ); end end
-- Merge paths merge AssetPath as T using ( select distinct I.GroupID as ID, SE.Segments from #ids I cross apply ( select g.XMLData as Segments from #tblgrp g where g.GroupID = I.GroupID ) SE ) as S on (S.ID = T.ID) when matched then update set T.Segments = S.Segments when not matched then insert (ID, Segments) values (S.ID, S.Segments);
--Queue Search index updates to path, except when this procedure is called for an entire asset type insert into [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) select 'ObjectIndex', 'Path', a.Object, a.ObjectID, S.ID FROM [dbo].[asset] a inner join #ids S on S.ID = a.ID and S.GroupID = S.ID; end end
